heard: Two speeding space probes drifted off course for 30 years. In 1972 and 1973, NASA launched Pioneer 10 and 11 to the outer solar system. Because they were spin stabilized, they were the most precisely tracked spacecraft in history. By 1980, scientists noticed both probes were experiencing an unexpected deceleration. Some physicists speculated the anomaly might indicate a breakdown in general relativity. Researchers found old magnetic tracking tapes stored under a staircase at the jet propulsion laboratory. In 2012, scientists proved the probes were simply shining infrared waste heat out of their own instruments. Waste heat from electrical instruments pushed them backward like a microscopic headlight, proving why two speeding space probes drifted off course for 30 years.
